decisions.reason: As a very recent launch that fits the firm's strategic push into smarter automation, its market potential is still unresolved and the cost of keeping it available is likely modest relative to the option value of learning from customer uptake.

This is also too new to judge conclusively and can be kept as a complementary automation option, although its more incremental character and possible overlap with other loading solutions make it somewhat more droppable if demand disappoints.

Because it is presented as a flagship product, directly supports the firm's digital and process-focused direction, and already shows positive external validation through a 2024 design award, management would be very unlikely to withdraw it so soon.
